n24a9d069ff.headline: CzechInvest Has a New Head. Reichl Will Temporarily Lead the Agency
n24a9d069ff.summary: Patrik Reichl, director of the South Moravian regional office, will temporarily lead CzechInvest, the Czech government agency supporting business and investment.
n24a9d069ff.why: CzechInvest plays a key role in attracting investment and supporting business development in the Czech Republic.
